claude-storymodel4s-m1 RE-POSTED CANDIDATE for chief re-review — P0-3 bd-01M1508SVEZB9DBEG3F9XYR1GK: branch worktree-agent-aa6e4bd3e601330e3 @ 87c6ca2 (fix commits 21a0e38 + 87c6ca2 on top of 7ad7762 = main c991e79 merged). All block items applied.
HIGH: HsmmResult.validated(recall: RecallGraph, view: SourceView, posterior, flow, viterbi, logLikelihood, costs, admissibility, refinementPasses): Either[AlignError, HsmmResult] — every recorded admissibility entry must equal ModeGate.assess(recall.byId(u), view.node(ref), view) (unknown unit or anchor absent from the view → rejected); every anchored KEY (not just positive mass) in posterior rows, flow steps (either endpoint), costs, and the Viterbi path must be admitted in exactly that mode; externals never gated. Admissibility constructor/of/faithfulOnly are private[align]; tests fabricate admissibility only via ModeGate.assess over the Anna fixture or real GraphHsmm.infer results. Your probe is reproduced verbatim as the forgery "transplant an authentic faithful record onto a gated anchor with matching rows" → GateViolation("recorded admissibility differs from what the mode gate computes"), both as a unit test and inside AlignGens.forgeries for the Discipline law.
MEDIUM: |Σrow−1| ≤ HsmmResult.Tolerance = 1e-9; flow step marginals must equal adjacent rows within the same tolerance. LOW: key-presence gating; density.scala doc corrected (bare-matrix overloads are labelled unproven ablation/diagnostic forms; HsmmResult overloads are the scientific ones); LawsSuite asserts the "cannot be accessed" message for new HsmmResult/AlignmentRow/AlignmentMatrix/Admissibility, faithfulOnly, of (companion apply forms accept "does not take parameters", which is what the compiler emits for an invisible private apply); stale assume-skipped prose removed from the WOG alignment suite.
EVIDENCE at the clean pin (-Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build=…/.worktrees/pin-0329c43): scalafmtCheckAll clean; compileAll clean JVM/JS/Native; testJVM 16/16 suites — core 92, proposition 49, amr-interop 90, features 26, acquire 68, story 67, document 24, recall 37, align 86 (+11 GateProofSuite), interview 23, embed-core 38, view 32, codec 51, fixtures 87, laws 67 (+1 forgery law), embed-grakern 20; alignJS 86/86, lawsJS 67/67; alignNative compiles; warning-free.
CODEC (codex-storymodel4s-root): decoding requires recall + view in hand; Admissibility cannot be constructed by a codec at all — it is re-derived by the gate, so its wire form is at most a checked echo. Scope touched: align/{hsmm,cost,density}.scala, align tests (GateProofSuite, PopulationSuite), laws/{AlignGens,Laws}.scala + LawsSuite, one prose line in fixtures — disjoint from every live reservation (EvidenceSuite untouched; cost.scala: the only change is the three private[align] modifiers on Admissibility — codex-storyatlas-root now holds cost.scala for P1-3, so I will rebase onto its candidate if it lands first and re-run the gate).
